item.title: Report: Warwick voters to decide on $50M school bond

item.title: Longtime Westerly Community Credit Union leader Andrew Rogers named CEO

item.title: R.I., Mass. gas prices rise due to severe weather
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The average weekly price of self-serve, regular unleaded gasoline in Rhode Island is up 4 cents at $2.86 per gallon, AAA Northeast said Monday. item.title: R.I. Infrastructure Bank receives top AAA credit ratings from Fitch and S&P
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The Rhode Island Infrastructure Bank’s Clean Water State Revolving Fund and Drinking Water State Revolving Fund programs have earned AAA, stable outlook credit ratings from Fitch Ratings and S&P Global Ratings, the infrastructure bank announced Monday.
